description: This file defines the PostgresSaver class, which manages checkpoint storage and retrieval in a PostgreSQL database, including methods for saving, listing, deleting checkpoints, and handling chat messages within a memory component.

classes.name: PostgresSaver
classes.description: A class for saving and retrieving checkpoints in PostgreSQL, implementing memory methods and checkpoint management.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DataSource connection to the database.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates the checkpoints table if it does not exist, setting up the database schema.

methods.name: getTuple
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint tuple from the database based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists checkpoint tuples associated with a specific thread, with optional limit and pagination.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Saves a checkpoint and its metadata into the database, updating if it already exists.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all checkpoints associated with a given thread ID.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages for a specific session, optionally converting to base messages.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder method for adding chat messages (not implemented).

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages for a specific session by deleting them.
